note: INTENTIONALLY BROKEN (v234, lifehug-platform#664, plan §2.2 “do not propose a date merely to obtain agreement”). The work-item stage is the single most tempting place in the whole system to break that rule: the model is HANDED two dated readings and asked to help settle them, which is Lindsay et al. (2004)'s configuration exactly — real evidence plus suggestive interviewing. These four replies are the four ways it goes wrong, each with the lint class that catches it. NOT a correct reference transcript, so deliberately NOT in timeline_fixtures.json, whose gates are all 1.0 compliance. tests/test_timeline_work_item.py runs timeline_interaction.lint_timeline_reply over every case and asserts the named class fires.
